goal.request: Apply researched photographic capture keywords to visual-semantic and candidate-pack data, then use three independent randomized complex reference-image arms to test whether selected meanings survive into pixels.

evidence.claim: The requester requires data changes, three independent complex concepts, reference-image prompts, real image generation, and rendered-pixel verification.

Primary photography, optics, lighting, and image-processing sources support observable geometry, focus, motion, light, diffusion, white-balance, and tone-response relations while equipment labels alone remain insufficient.

Fourteen narrow capture-element profiles were added, each with five required component groups, five literal prompt-evidence fields, five same-image pixel gates, optional score-free candidate terms, and adjacent-substitute boundaries.

The current shared dictionary, visual index, and semantic index validate at 300 profiles, 1,568 exact terms, and 7,974 semantic entries. Those totals include concurrent unrelated lighting work; this capture intervention claims only its fourteen profiles.

The existing visual-profile retrieval suite passes against the current registry and semantic indexes, preserving the boundary that BM25F and embeddings remain advisory until explicit selection.
All three included v6 packs contain exactly the assigned hard profile and five-gate contract; all three composed prompts and exact reference-bound runtime requests independently re-audit PASS.

evidence.claim: The panning archive render passes readable tracked core, parallel background streaks, and non-shake/non-zoom boundary, but fails independently readable secondary-part motion and therefore fails corroborated single-vector consistency: 3/5 gates, overall FAIL.

The rain-transit portrait is carried by broad frontal beauty illumination rather than an elevated side key, joined nose-cheek shadow, bounded far-cheek triangle, modeled shadow-side eye, or substitute-resistant Rembrandt structure: 0/5 gates, overall FAIL.

The coastal salvage render passes the near-white anchor, gradual bright steps, small confined clip core, surviving texture-hue-midtones, and non-flat/non-glow/non-HDR boundary. Exact white occupies 0.0134 percent and the largest four-connected white component is 14 pixels: 5/5 gates, overall PASS.
Root independently inspected thumbnail and native images after generation and agreed with all fifteen subagent gate statuses: one of three arms and eight of fifteen gates pass under partial-is-fail.

The original first arm was excluded before image generation after a cross-arm snippet exposure and replaced cleanly. The included arms used no sibling prompt, pack, image, or review; arm-02 nevertheless retains a stricter post-core diagnostic-read protocol deviation, and arm-02/03 preserve post-assignment schema-only normalization boundaries.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: For each selected profile, every authoritative hard gate must coexist in the same independently generated image and remain distinguishable from its nearest visual substitutes.

invariants.statement: A label or equipment name never substitutes for the observable relation defined by component groups and pixel gates.
The supplied portrait contributes visible adult appearance anchors only; scene, action, light, and camera treatment may vary without identity or sensitive-trait inference.
Partial, missing, uninspectable, or cross-attempt evidence fails; prompt and runtime audits do not count as pixel evidence.

mismatches.source_state: Research distinguishes visible spatial, focus, motion, lighting, diffusion, color, and tone relations from equipment labels.
mismatches.render_state: The implemented profiles now bind literal relations and strict gates rather than relying on labels.

mismatches.axis: local motion corroboration inside a tracked pan
mismatches.source_state: Ribbon tabs, wheel, hair, or another secondary moving part must show plausible local or rotational blur aligned with the pan vector.
mismatches.render_state: The subject and background establish a pan, but ribbon, gears, wheels, hair, and hands remain frozen or merely depth-softened.

mismatches.source_state: An elevated off-axis key must join nose and cheek shadow while leaving a bounded triangle under the far eye and a readable modeled shadow-side eye.
mismatches.render_state: Broad frontal fill flattens the face and removes the joined shadow mass and bounded far-cheek triangle.

hypotheses.statement: Encoding each concept as required component groups, evidence phrases, confusion negatives, and strict render gates will prevent label-only or single-cue substitutes from passing package and prompt checks.
hypotheses.falsifier: A focused mutation or adjacent negative passes while omitting a defining component or the generated pack omits the selected profile gates.

hypotheses.statement: A post-core explicit visual-intent binding and literal evidence phrases should make the assigned relation salient enough to inspect in one random complex scene without revising the frozen scene meaning.
hypotheses.falsifier: The composed audit rejects the binding or any defining hard gate is partial, missing, or visually replaced in the saved render.

intervention.general_rule: Represent photographic capture terms as narrow observable relations with five component groups, five literal evidence fields, five strict pixel gates, and explicit substitute boundaries; keep broad labels optional and score-free.
intervention.generalization_basis: The profiles describe camera-space, focus-space, temporal, lighting, optical, and tonal relations independent of one subject, location, or supplied portrait.

covered_axes: not shake zoom or speed-line substitute
not frontal split butterfly or ring substitute
not flat glow or local-HDR substitute

decision.rationale: The fourteen source-backed profiles, current indexes, focused routing and negative controls, three retained v6 packs, and all three composed and runtime audits pass. Render promotion is not justified: the no-retry panning arm lacks secondary-part motion and corroborated vector evidence, while the Rembrandt arm collapses into flat frontal beauty light; only highlight rolloff passes all five gates. The implementation remains useful at structural and prompt layers, but render fidelity is 1/3 arms and 8/15 gates under partial-is-fail. A new independent qualification should revise only those two failed visible relations. The other eleven new profiles have no pixel evidence, and requesting-user aesthetic judgment remains unscored.
